doc.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000

title: Dream band question
summary: Sol turns the dream band question back to Monk.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: My goodness. If you could put together a dream band, from all the people in the past, who would you put on there.
I would have Monk Rowe select them for me.
You pick them out for me my dear friend.
And you’d corral them and I bet we’d have some great music.
I’ll let you pick them out.
So you’re working seven nights a week.
